verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only discusses llama.cpp's default mmap behavior and its performance implications (comm-1), but never documents CLI flags or config options letting a power-user override mmap/mlock or other low-level engine settings. Missing for 10: any mention of --mlock, --no-mmap, or equivalent override flags, docs on tuning memory-locking behavior, or independent confirmation these settings are user-configurable.
